title: List of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition

entities.name: List of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition
entities.description: An information element that may be included by an allowed PLMN to assign a new list of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition associated with the serving PLMN to the UE.

entities.name: Allowed PLMN
entities.description: A PLMN that is permitted to include the list of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition information element.

entities.name: Serving PLMN
entities.description: The PLMN currently serving the UE, with which the list of PLMNs for disaster condition is associated.

relations.description: An allowed PLMN may include the list of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition IE.
The list of PLMNs to be used in disaster condition is associated with the serving PLMN.
